versions.content: Individual random timer for ProvidedServiceInstance service discovery If ProvidedServiceInstance s reference their own SomeipS- dServerServiceInstanceConfig in the role of sdServerTimerConfig , then the timing behavior is handled per ProvidedServiceInstance . Thus, every Pro- videdServiceInstance has its own calculated random timer based on the min and max value of the InitialSdDelayConfig . If the calculated random timer expires, then a OfferService entry of the referencing ProvidedServiceInstance shall be sent out.
